description: This file defines the LiteModuleLoader class, which provides static methods to load TorchScript models and modules from disk or assets within an Android environment, supporting different devices and configurations.

classes.name: LiteModuleLoader
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to load TorchScript modules from various sources within an Android application.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a serialized TorchScript module from a given file path, optionally with extra files and device specification.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a serialized TorchScript module from a given file path, defaulting to CPU device.

methods.name: loadModuleFromAsset
methods.description: Loads a TorchScript module from the Android application's assets, specifying the device.

methods.name: loadModuleFromAsset
methods.description: Loads a TorchScript module from the assets using CPU device by default.
